name: Institutional Support for Development and Marketing of Tribal Products/Produce
benefit:
**Activities to be undertaken under the Scheme:** 
> **Market Intervention:** The various aspects of marketing intervention which will be supported under this scheme are:-

   1. fixation of equitable prices for existing products both manmade and natural;
   1. Actual procurement by State agencies as a safety net program and not monopoly/nationalization.
   1. Support during seasons of harvest
_eligibility_text:
**Support under the scheme will be made available to:**

   1. Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation (TRIFED),
   1. State Tribal Development Cooperative Corporations,
   1. State Forest Development Corporations (SDCs),
   1. Minor Forest produce (Trading and Development) Federations (MFPTDFs),
   1. Other institutions identified for product design, development, export processing, training of tribal producers, patenting and trademark, research, GI certification, and activities ancillary to the above.
